proposal.description: The cool-down is treated as finished only once the counter has gone past the target instead of reaching it, so the counter runs on to target+1 and hiccup_done is raised one clock late
proposal.reason: In every S_HICCUP visit, hiccup_done goes high one clk later than base_clks<<strike_level clocks after entry, so the supervisor leaves S_HICCUP for S_SS one clock late. This is the late counterpart of the existing 'raised one clock early' mutant.
